title: GOES-East full-disk AI nowcasting of cloud evolution in observation space: Code and Models
description: Software for training and deploying AI nowcasting models for GOES-East full-disk infrared brightness temperatures. Extends the CREDIT (Community Research Earth Digital Intelligence Twin) framework with direct observation prediction (DOP+) conditioned on meteorological fields. Forecasts cloud evolution at 10-minute resolution across the GOES-East full disk (~10^8 km^2) out to 6-hour lead times.
